# Paying and reporting PAYG withholding amounts for small and medium withholders
How to pay and report PAYG withholding amounts if you're a small and medium withholder.

**Last updated** 21 November 2025

Print or Download

## On this page
- [What are small withholders](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/payg-withholding/paying-and-reporting-withheld-amounts/paying-and-reporting-payg-withholding-amounts-for-small-and-medium-withholders#ato-Whataresmallwithholders)
- [What are medium withholders](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/payg-withholding/paying-and-reporting-withheld-amounts/paying-and-reporting-payg-withholding-amounts-for-small-and-medium-withholders#ato-Whataremediumwithholders)

## What are small withholders
Small withholders are those who withhold $25,000 or less per financial year. They:

- pay withholding amounts to us each quarter
- report withholding on activity statements received each quarter
- can arrange to receive monthly activity statements by [phoning our business services number](https://www.ato.gov.au/about-ato/contact-us#Speaktoacustomerservicerepresentative).

## What are medium withholders
Medium withholders are those who withhold $25,001 to $1 million per financial year. They:

- pay withholding amounts to us each month
- report withholding on activity statements received each month.

# Paying and reporting PAYG withholding amounts to us
## PAYGW withholding cycles
- $25,000 or less (small withholder status) – you are required to notify and pay quarterly
- more than $25,000 and up to $1 million (medium withholder status) – you are required to notify and pay monthly
- more than $1 million (large withholder status) – you are required to pay electronically within 6 to 8 days of a withholding event taking place, such as when staff are paid.

## When to pay PAYG withholding amounts
| If you withhold an amount on: | You must pay the withheld amount to us on: |
|-|-|
| Monday or Tuesday | the following Monday |
| Wednesday | second Thursday after that day |
| Thursday or Friday | the following Thursday |
| Saturday or Sunday | second Monday after that day |

## Large withholder's discretionary extensions to payments
- 0.5% of the amount you withheld in the previous financial year
- $50,000.

## Large withholders that are unable to pay withheld amounts
- call us on **1300 728 060**.

For each withheld amount that you are unable to pay or need to correct, we need to know the:

- amount owed
- date the withholding applies to
- reason you are unable to pay that amount by the due date, or
- reason for correction.

## Large withholders may offset a net GST credit against a PAYG withholding liability
- lodge your BAS on or before the due date – it will establish your entitlement to a GST credit.
- pay the amount owing to us by the due date. If any credit remains after the offset, it will be offset against other tax liabilities or refunded to you. We can't refund any amount unless you have lodged all required activity statements.

# Changes to your PAYG withholding cycle
- between $25,000 and $1 million ( [medium withholder](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/payg-withholding/paying-and-reporting-withheld-amounts/paying-and-reporting-payg-withholding-amounts-for-small-and-medium-withholders) status), you'll need to report on your activity statement and pay monthly
- more than $1 million ( [large withholder](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/payg-withholding/paying-and-reporting-withheld-amounts/paying-and-reporting-payg-withholding-amounts-for-large-withholders) status) you'll need to pay electronically within six to eight days from the day you withheld the amount, such as when staff are paid.

If you're a large withholder, you'll get a unique Payment Reference Number (PRN) to quote when you pay.

web.title: Changing a withholding cycle | Australian Taxation Office
web.description:
# Changing a withholding cycle
## PAYG withholding cycle
- $25,000 or less (small withholder status) – you are required to notify and pay quarterly
- more than $25,000 and up to $1 million (medium withholder status) – you are required to notify and pay monthly
- more than $1 million (large withholder status) – you are required to pay electronically within 6 to 8 days of a withholding event taking place, such as when staff are paid. Large withholders are also issued with a unique payment reference number (PRN).

## ATO annual review
Your new withholding cycle will be determined by your new [withholder status](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/payg-withholding/paying-and-reporting-withheld-amounts/changing-a-withholding-cycle#Withholdingstatus) (medium or large).
